title: Uruguayan Chicken Skewers with Nutty Crust
description: Delicious Uruguayan-inspired chicken skewers with a nutty and crispy crust, perfect for a French-inspired meal. Serve with your favorite sides for a complete meal.
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together nutty crust mix, olive oil, lemon juice, and garlic powder.
Thread chicken breast onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush nutty crust mix mixture onto chicken breast.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes, or until chicken is cooked through.
Serve with uruguayan chimichurri sauce for dipping.
Note: Make sure to cook chicken to an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C) to ensure food safety.
